1.name: The Tvovänlivenghausen
1.overview: Oscar, a 22-year-old aspiring doctor, arrives in Sweden hoping for a fresh start. But his excitement quickly turns into chaos when he discovers he has nowhere to live. With the help of Nora, a suspiciously enthusiastic letting agent, he tours a series of bizarre apartments before meeting Erik, his laid-back new roommate. Just when Oscar thinks his troubles are over, a mysterious clause in his rental contract reveals that Swedish traditions might be stranger than he ever imagined.

1.name: Fika, Friends & a Blackout
1.overview: Oscar tries to settle into his new life with Erik, but Nora's surprise visit, his first fika, and new friendships bring fresh chaos. Just as things begin to feel normal, an unexpected blackout turns everything upside down.

1.name: Lights Out, Chaos On
1.overview: With the neighbourhood plunged into darkness, Oscar and Erik attempt to survive a night without electricity. Their plans for a peaceful evening quickly unravel when they meet Simon, a quirky technology enthusiast with unusual inventions and questionable solutions. Between candlelit dinners, ridiculous games, and Erik's constant teasing, Oscar begins to wonder whether his new life will ever be normal.

1.name: The VIPs Have Landed
1.overview: The electricity is finally restored, just in time for the arrival of Selma and her parents. Determined to impress his visitors, Oscar prepares the perfect welcome, but his nerves and unfamiliarity with Swedish life threaten to ruin everything. As old friendships reunite and Erik joins the excitement, Oscar discovers that showing off his new home is considerably harder than he imagined.

1.name: The Grand Tour
1.overview: Oscar proudly takes Selma and her parents on a tour of his new life in Sweden, from cozy restaurants to the university campus. Between embarrasticipated. But when Selma's father offers financial assistance, Oscar faces a difficult reminder of why becoming independent matters so much to him.

1.name: The Boy Before Swedensing stories, unexpected encounters, and Erik's questionable humour, the day becomes an adventure nobody an
1.overview: A familiar conversation with Selma sends Oscar down memory lane, revealing his life before moving to Scandinavia. Growing up with limited resources but enormous ambitions, Oscar balances school, family responsibilities, and his dream of becoming a doctor. Through hilarious childhood memories and touching moments with his grandmother, the story reveals the young man behind the suitcase.

1.name: Exams, Secrets & Scandals
1.overview: In a flashback to his final school days, Oscar and Selma prepare for important examinations while an unexpected scandal threatens Selma's wealthy family. As rumours spread and the police investigate her father, Oscar tries to support his best friend without sacrificing his own future. Meanwhile, growing frustration with corruption and inequality begins to change how Oscar sees his homeland.

1.name: One-Way Ticket
1.overview: As Oscar remembers the difficult months leading up to his departure, his determination to find a better future grows stronger. Between university applications, financial worries, and emotional conversations with Selma and his family, leaving home proves much harder than expected. With encouragement from his grandmother and a suitcase full of hopes, Oscar takes the first step toward a completely different life.

1.name: Lost in Translation
1.overview: Back in the present, Oscar attempts to settle into university life, but understanding Swedish customs proves almost as difficult as his medical studies. Language barriers, confusing campus routines, and awkward encounters with classmates turn an ordinary day into a comedy of errors. With Erik and Simon offering their own questionable advice, Oscar learns that surviving university requires more than good grades.

1.name: A Museum of Misunderstandings
1.overview: Oscar and Selma plan a relaxing day exploring a local museum, hoping to spend some quality time together. Their peaceful outing takes a ridiculous turn when Erik unexpectedly appears and decides to entertain himself with practical jokes. As harmless teasing escalates into a competition of increasingly absurd pranks, Oscar discovers that getting revenge on Erik is easier said than done.

1.name: The Pineapple Conspiracy
1.overview: After a day of sightseeing and laughter, Erik invites Oscar and Selma home for a relaxing evening of homemade pizza and games. But Erik has a secret ingredient that Oscar absolutely despises: pineapple. What begins as an innocent dinner becomes a hilarious battle of culinary deception, while Oscar and Selma gradually realize that their friendship might be developing into something more.

1.name: More Than Friend
1.overview: As Selma's visit approaches its end, Oscar stsruggles to understand the feelings he has kept hidden for years. With Erik's encouragement, unexpected interruptions, and one final series of awkward misunderstandings, Oscar prepares to tell Selma what she truly means to him. Against the beautiful evening skyline of Lund, two childhood friends face a moment that could change their relationship forever.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: When Oscar leaves behind his modest life and economic struggles in Bosnia to pursue his long-held dream of attending medical school in Lund, Sweden, he anticipates a straightforward path to a brighter future. However, reality proves far more unpredictable than the pristine streets of his new home. Thrown into an unfamiliar world of high stakes academics, cultural adjustments, and sudden independence, Oscar finds his new life instantly upended by a colorful and eccentric cast of characters. Sharing a cramped, quirky apartment with Erik. A relaxed, California accented engineering student with strong opinions on pizza and dealing with Nora, a deadpan and scheming letting agent who thrives on chaos.
